scope: Exact capture-coordinate feature matrix for a fixed complete ordered CDF and a finite physical route bank; finite warp LP is not an unrestricted lower certificate.
convention: coefficient_ij = numerators_ij / denominator_j; payoff_j(d)=sum_i coefficient_ij*d_i; d_i>=0,sum_i d_i=1. Use strict regularization for a bijective physical warp.
